baseline.authority: Implement only the selected snapshot module, tests and bounded verification receipts under the accepted contract. Use disposable /tmp fixtures for real publication and recovery tests. Never invoke publication against active root canonical files or modify shared writer helpers, root installation, Template, Task, memory or Git.
criteria: Mixed-version inputs yield snapshot_changed/knowledge_updating; entry/relations/graph/cursor output never silently mixes snapshots.
Cache keys include selected root/project, snapshot, helper/adapter and presentation versions; cache memory/concurrency/lifetime are bounded.
Stale evidence does not erase safe canonical definitions and no read creates publication locks, repairs hashes or builds products.

Interrupted multi-file publication with stable bytes is rejected until existing owner state establishes completion or recovery; malformed or unreadable relevant coordination returns a safe bounded diagnostic.
Read-only coordination brackets materialization and covers missing-to-present lock races; ordinary browsing creates no lock, intent, receipt, repaired source hash or generated output.
baseline.deliverable: Exact coherent immutable snapshot adapter, deterministic transaction/race/cache/nonmutation tests, and bounded actual results. Preserve TASK-004 verification steps verbatim from the immutable plan.
baseline.objective: Implement a thin immutable snapshot adapter over load_project, complete pre/post selected-input digests and non-creating read-only observation of existing publication coordination; reject active or unresolved selected-input transactions, bound retries/cache lifetime and retire views after active readers finish.
baseline.rationale: The accepted extra-complex CONTRACTS synthesis fixes the publication, snapshot, loaded-byte and cache decisions. One accountable worker implements this exact bounded module and deterministic actual-publication tests; a discovered contract defect returns to the originating design cycle rather than being solved by a silent alternative.

slots.perspective: Implement frozen snapshot protocol with adversarial deterministic publication tests

baseline.stop: All five TASK-004 criteria pass direct current targeted evidence or a concrete contract defect is returned for manager reconciliation.
